prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: high-fidelity desktop web application direction comp, 16:10 landscape
Primary request: Design the first viewport of Sylph, a remote agentic product-building Workspace for solo developers and small engineering teams. The product itself is on stage; Sylph is the disciplined prompt desk coordinating every cue around it.
Scene/backdrop: Full-bleed desktop application at approximately 1600x1000, no device frame, no marketing page, no floating hero card.
Structure: A narrow Workspace ledger advances at far left; a continuous agent prompt book occupies the center; a large live browser preview dominates the right half; code and test evidence rise as cue sheets below the browser without becoming a generic terminal. Include compact top chrome with Sylph, repository and branch identity, live preview URL, and clear agent-control state.
Content: Workspace `Checkout restoration`, repository `folkhero-web`, agent session `Polish the onboarding flow`, active browser preview showing a tasteful SaaS onboarding screen, concise agent log with `Inspecting responsive state`, file change `src/routes/onboarding.tsx`, test result `Browser checks 4/4`, preview state `Live`, and explicit control `Agent controlling browser`.
Style/medium: Award-level production UI mockup grounded in stage-manager prompt books and live production desks, but all labels use literal engineering language. Blackened linen, cue paper, anodized aluminum, signal glass. Workhorse humanist sans with tightly condensed numerals; no decorative theater lettering.
Composition/framing: The browser is the undeniable focal surface. The active Workspace physically advances from the ledger. Adjacent regions remain legible but quiet. Use seams and overlaps rather than a grid of rounded cards.
Lighting/mood: Calm control room under soft task lighting; physical but restrained.
Color palette: near-black #11100E, bone #E9E2D2, oxblood #B8432D, signal teal #68B7B0. Color is confined to narrow live-state bands.
Materials/textures: subtle black linen, warm cue paper, etched metal rules, shallow signal glass; fine grain, no glossy sci-fi.
Text (verbatim where shown): `Sylph`, `Checkout restoration`, `folkhero-web`, `Polish the onboarding flow`, `Inspecting responsive state`, `src/routes/onboarding.tsx`, `Browser checks 4/4`, `Live`, `Agent controlling browser`.
Constraints: This must read instantly as an IDE-like product Workspace for code, agent conversation, browser preview, skills, and testing. Dense but not cramped. Keyboard-first cues. Accessible contrast. No fabricated customers or metrics.
Avoid: generic VS Code clone, generic dark dashboard, equal-weight bento cards, glowing neon borders, glassmorphism, excessive pills, terminal wallpaper, marketing copy, logos other than the Sylph wordmark, device mockups, illegible tiny text, theatrical costume motifs.
